title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Baylor University
description: Late-night dining at Baylor University is defined by a mix of on-campus traditions like Penland's late-night waffles and off-campus staples along the I-35 corridor and Speight Avenue.

cards.title: Late-Night Waffles at Penland
cards.subtitle: The primary on-campus late-night dining hall
cards.notes: Visit Monday through Thursday from 8 p.m. to midnight to enjoy the signature self-serve waffle stations and social atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: Penland Crossroads is the central hub for on-campus late-night dining, famous among students for its evening waffle service.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night is available from 8 p.m. to midnight Monday through Thursday at the Penland Crossroads.
cards.source_title: Expand Late Night, or bust - The Baylor Lariat
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Monday-Thursday for late-night service.

cards.title: Study Fuel at Moody Starbucks
cards.subtitle: Caffeine for late-night research sessions
cards.notes: Order ahead via Grubhub to skip the line during peak study hours in the Moody Memorial Library foyer.
cards.short_summary: Located in the heart of the library, this Starbucks serves as the primary caffeine source for students during late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Starbucks Coffee location in Moody Memorial Library extended its hours of operation on Mondays through Fridays until midnight.
cards.source_title: Moody Starbucks Extends Hours Beginning March 24 - Baylor Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on weekdays to support student research.

cards.title: Coffee and Community at Common Grounds
cards.subtitle: A bohemian staple adjacent to campus
cards.notes: Check the clipboard inside for open mic sign-ups or enjoy a 'Cowboy Coffee' on the backyard-turned-stage.
cards.short_summary: Common Grounds is a long-standing coffee house next to Baylor known for its unique atmosphere and live music events.
cards.evidence_claim: Common Grounds hosts an open mic every Wednesday night from 8:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Open mic nights around Waco offer a stage unlike any other - The Baylor Lariat
cards.access_notes: Hosts evening events like open mic nights until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Pizza Pillows at Shorty's
cards.subtitle: New York-style slices near the 12th Street corridor
cards.notes: Order a signature Pizza Pillow or a slice by the pie on the large covered patio near the Baylor campus.
cards.short_summary: Shorty's is a popular student haunt specializing in New York-style pizza and 'Pizza Pillows' with a laid-back outdoor patio.
cards.evidence_claim: Shorty's Baylor location at 1712 S. 12th St. is open from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 11 p.m. at the 12th Street location.

cards.title: Warm Cookie Delivery on Speight
cards.subtitle: Late-night sweets delivered to dorms
cards.notes: Visit the Speight Avenue storefront for warm cookies or ice cream sandwiches well past midnight.
cards.short_summary: Insomnia Cookies provides late-night bakery treats and delivery services specifically catering to the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies at 1508 Speight Ave offers warm cookie delivery and baked treats until late night.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies | Warm Cookie Delivery & Baked Treats Until Late Night
cards.access_notes: Specializes in late-night service and delivery to the Baylor area.

cards.title: 24-Hour Honey Butter Chicken Biscuits
cards.subtitle: The quintessential Texas 24-hour run
cards.notes: Head to the 7th Street location for a late-night burger or breakfast starting at 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Texas institution, this 24-hour Whataburger is a frequent destination for students after late-night events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Whataburger at 928 S 7th St in Waco is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 928 S 7TH ST WACO, TX

cards.title: Cane's Sauce and Chicken Fingers
cards.subtitle: Late-night fuel along the I-35 frontage road
cards.notes: The Kultgen Expressway location serves chicken finger meals until 1 a.m. on most nights.
cards.short_summary: Raising Cane's is a popular fast-food choice for Baylor students, known for its limited menu and signature sauce.
cards.evidence_claim: The Raising Cane's at 801 S Kultgen Expressway is open until 1:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Waco, TX - 801 S Kultgen Expressway

cards.title: Midnight Pancakes at IHOP
cards.subtitle: 24-hour breakfast near campus
cards.notes: Located just off I-35, this IHOP provides a full breakfast menu at any hour for late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: This 24-hour IHOP serves as a reliable late-night dining option for students seeking a sit-down meal.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP at 4109 South Jack Kultgen Expy is open 24 hours and offers late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Breakfast in Waco, TX on 4109 South Jack Kultgen Expy

cards.title: The Original Gut Pak
cards.subtitle: A legendary Waco barbecue tradition
cards.notes: Visit on Friday or Saturday evenings until 8 p.m. to try the famous Gut Pak in the biergarten.
cards.short_summary: Vitek's is home to the 'Gut Pak,' a famous combination of Fritos, brisket, and sausage that is a staple for the Baylor community.
cards.evidence_claim: Vitek's Market is open Friday-Saturday from 10:30 AM to 8:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 8 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.

cards.title: Late-Night Croissant Donuts
cards.subtitle: Artisanal treats in downtown Waco
cards.notes: Stop by the 4th Street location for fresh handmade donuts and espresso in an inviting ambiance.
cards.short_summary: Nightlight Donuts offers high-quality donuts and coffee, transitioning from a popular food truck to a permanent storefront.
cards.evidence_claim: Nightlight Donuts & Coffee is located at 319 S. 4th Street and offers fresh hand-made donuts.
cards.source_title: Nightlight Donuts & Coffee - Visit Waco, TX
cards.access_notes: Check daily for availability as popular flavors often sell out early.
